restriction_review.scope: Thirty absent Underfoot Tinkering input bodies, IDs3094542–3094571: one Collapsed Chronal Transmutation Device, Cosgrite Gear Assembly, seven Cosgrove slot seals and 21 Stalwart cultural armor pieces. All30 selected full-input signatures are absent across skills and enabled/disabled states; selected output/name snapshots are also empty.
restriction_review.era: Maintained-primary reconstruction. Expansion floor16 is a proposed configured availability POLICY based on the current Underfoot catalogue, with maximum-1. It is not a recovered introduction date or immutable2013 formula receipt. Recipe/item numbers, native creation timestamps and the later Artisan Prize association on Cosgrite Gear Assembly do not authenticate introduction. No earlier-family availability is inferred.
restriction_review.learning: All21 Stalwart armor views explicitly require skill300 and purchasing/scribing Stalwart Gnomish Cultural Tinkering. Preserve skillneeded300, must_learn1 and learned_by_item_id50668. The other nine views propose ordinary minimum0/must_learn0/book0; no quest-only gate is inferred from a later quest association. The book is a learning dependency, not a combine ingredient. No player learning, book supply, vendor, UI or native acceptance is claimed.
restriction_review.authored_context: Native book50668 is class2/type60, filename TSCultTinkeringGNM85. Its retained text describes vanadium/immaculate templates, steely fortified bronze, spongy loam/brimstone fuel, gears/sprockets or cogs/two contraption parts, and the cloth thread/fluid/filament context. The book authenticates this native learning context, while the primary catalogue supplies individual quantities, trivials and kit lists. The text is pinned by hash and remains unchanged.
restriction_review.quantity: All30 views explicitly yield1 and provide exact numeric trivials. Positive component quantities, including repeated heat sources/parts, are retained. There are no source success/failure tool-return fields, so none are invented. Consumed-component salvagecount=componentcount follows local policy for new rows, not historical salvage authentication.
restriction_review.containers: Positive per-view physical kit links only. Collapsed Chronal Transmutation Device and Cosgrite Gear Assembly each list Toolbox17902, Deluxe Toolbox17877 and Collapsible Toolbox17276. Seven Cosgrove seals and21 armor formulas list only Deluxe Toolbox17877 among the selected portable kits. Native ordinary/collapsible kits have8 slots and Deluxe has10; all have size4/bagtype10. Every selected body fits its listed kit. No generic10 entry, inferred extra portable kit or optional world-table link is added.
restriction_review.preservation: 100 primary item references resolved, then101 selected native dependencies including the learning book read fresh. All30 full-input multiset checks use an indexed required positive component and aggregate totals/per-item sums; no global scan. New IDs/entries only; native items, existing recipes, character learning, inventory, quest data and race/skill access stay untouched.
restriction_review.limits: Source proposal only, pending Coordinator floor16/current-primary/gate/kit dispositions, exact GitHub publication and separate SQL GO. No SQL invocation, rehearsal, new tests, compilation, runtime, client, schema or API changes. Data source matching is not Gnome actor eligibility, actual crafting or historical-universe closure.
